pages.text: One evening, Mila walks with her family and sees streets glowing with tiny lights.
Some families place small lamps by doors to share hope and welcome.
Others hang paper lanterns that sway softly in the night air.
In another town, candles shine on windows during a winter celebration.
Mila hears drums and songs as neighbors gather to celebrate together.
At one table, people share sweets and fruit. At another, they share warm soup.
Mila learns that light can mean joy, peace, or a fresh start for many people.
An adult reminds children: look with your eyes, and stay close when candles are lit.
Every celebration has its own name and story, but many share love and community.
Mila goes home smiling. She learned that lights can bring people together.
